messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — cloud partner asked for a combined Terraform ref-kit that supports GCP + Azure marketplace packaging for our Dedicated offering. Who owns module, examples, CI, and partner handoff checklist? Target partner QA in 2 weeks. Need: VPC peering example, KMS/KV integration, GPU SKU mapping, and a tiny private deployment sample. :calendar:
Samir Patel: I can own GCP module. Plan to reuse the infra-kit flavor mapping. Suggest variables: redwood_project, redwood_region, redwood_cluster. CI: GH Actions matrix for validate/plan/apply-destroy. Keep the quickstart tiny (one zone).
Jia Wei: I’ll own Azure side. Marketplace requires an ARM snippet for the offer plus a Terraform AKS example with VNET peering and managed identity. Also include Key Vault RBAC example and packaging notes for the Marketplace offer manifest.
Ben Ortiz: From past handoffs, checklist = README, examples/simple, examples/ha, smoke test (deploy+healthcheck), CI (validate/plan/apply-destroy), license/NOTICE, security review signoff. Add: cost estimate table (GPU SKUs + expected token ops) and model-size guidance.
CloudPartnerBot: CI Pipeline: terraform-gh-action matrix triggered for [gcp,azure]. Job samples/gcp/simple failed: terraform plan error -> missing variable 'project'.
Maria Chen: @Samir please add minimal quickstart that uses provider aliasing. Example snippet: ```hcl
provider \"google\" {
  project = var.project
  region  = var.region
}
module \"redwood_inference\" {
  source = \"./modules/inference\"
  project = var.project
}
```
Samir Patel: Will do. Also include an outputs.tf with lb_ip and api_endpoint. README should recommend prefix cache settings and batching defaults to hit latency SLOs.
Jia Wei: For Azure, include policy assignment snippet + managed identity example. Note: Marketplace offer packaging needs offerId and planId placeholders and an example command for the publisher portal.
Laura Nguyen: Ops request: CI smoke should run a `curl` against /health after apply and teardown on success. Use secrets injected via sealer or GH Actions secrets (do not commit). Add a small `smoke-test.sh` that retries 5x.
Ben Ortiz: For the marketplace announcement timeline: legal needs 5 business days to review offer copy. Partnerships PM needs final listing copy 7 days before publish. Who will draft the listing language? @Maria
Maria Chen: I'll draft a partner-facing playbook (refkit-playbook.md) with checklist, timeline (dev -> partner QA -> legal -> marketplace publish), contact list, and rollback plan. I'll share the draft by EOD Wednesday. :rocket:
Samir Patel: Can we have a 30m handoff with partner engineers? Proposed slots: Thu 14:00 PT or Fri 10:00 PT. Also need to know whether partner or Redwood will run the smoke tests in their account.
Jia Wei: Thu 14:00 PT works for me. Also I'll add a varset example for private vs hosted endpoints and a note about required egress rules for model downloads.
Maria Chen: Action items: Maria - playbook draft; Samir - GCP module + quickstart; Jia - Azure module + marketplace snippet; Ben - coordinate legal & announcement timing; Laura - CI smoke template. I’ll create the GH repo + initial skeleton and post link here once ready.
Samir Patel: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/pull/123 — contains modules/gcp/simple and README skeleton.
CloudPartnerBot: Lint report: PR #123 -> terraform fmt/validate passed; 1 GH Action job queued for plan.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — will follow up after the handoff. If anyone needs to split tasks further ping me.
